subject: Request: additional onboarding credit & short-term top-up — SparkLabs
messages:
From: Priya Singh <priya@sparklabs.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ekrem Ozdemir <ekrem@activeloop.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — extra onboarding credits for cohort

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — the team loved the latency profile on streaming generation. We just got accepted into SparkLabs' summer cohort and the program requires a short burst of experimentation right at kickoff (heavy multi-turn evals + embedding runs for dataset search).

Our standard startup package is helpful, but we'd hit that cap within days for the pilot. Is there a one-time top-up or onboarding credit you can offer for the next 8–12 weeks? We're not asking for an ongoing discount — just a short runway so we can validate the integration and demonstrate value to the SparkLabs mentors.

Estimated extra usage: ~150M tokens over 8 weeks + 30K embedding units (see attached usage estimates).

Ideal next steps: 1) Can you confirm if a short-term credit is possible? 2) If yes, what would you need from our side (PO, short MSA amendment, order form)?

Appreciate it,
Priya Singh
Founder & CTO, SparkLabs
priya@sparklabs.io
Attachment: usage-estimates-sparklabs.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya@sparklabs.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — extra onboarding credits for cohort

Hi Priya — great news on the cohort, congrats!

We can do a short-term top-up credit to cover the initial experimentation window. High-level proposal:
- One-time credits: $10,000 (roughly covers the 150M token + embedding estimate you provided)
- Validity: 90 days from issuance
- Requirement: signed order-form amendment (PDF) + confirmation of billing contact
- Optional: if you commit to a 6-month paid usage minimum after the trial, we can increase the credit to $15,000 and offer 10% off query pricing for the first 3 months.

I've attached an amendment and the order form stub for legal/finance to review. If that sounds reasonable I can loop in Marissa for approvals and get this into DocuSign.

Notes: we want to avoid setting a precedent for permanent free credits — this is framed as a time-boxed onboarding concession tied to the SparkLabs cohort.

Next step: do you prefer the standard one-time credit ($10k) or the conditional enhanced offer ($15k + 10% off with 6mo minimum)?

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Lead, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Attachment: Sparklabs_OrderForm_Amendment_v1.pdf (PDF)

Marissa / Monica — forwarding SparkLabs request. Summary: founder Priya Singh accepted to SparkLabs cohort; asks for short-term top-up ~150M tokens + 30K embeddings. Proposed offers:

Option A (standard): one-time credit $10k, 90-day validity, signing of order-form amendment.
Option B (enhanced, requires commitment): $15k credit + 10% off usage for 3 months if SparkLabs signs a 6-month committed spend (min TCV $30k).

Background: SparkLabs is early-stage but high-signal (good mentors, potential for referral/market credibility). I recommend Option B if we can get a 6-month minimum — higher uplift and reduces churn risk. If finance/legal push back, Option A is acceptable to get them live.

Request: approvals for issuing a one-time credit (either amount), confirmation on whether we can attach a conditional 10% promo and the wording legal needs for the amendment. Also, is Sales Ops able to route this through DocuSign by EOD Fri?

Jonas

Jonas — thanks for the clear summary. Finance is OK with a one-time concession for accelerator cohorts but wants guardrails. Approve Option B conditionally with the following constraints:
1) Credit cap: $15,000 max; issue as account credit line that converts to invoice credit only after usage is recorded.
2) Promo discount: 10% off for 3 months as proposed, but only applies to paid usage after the credit is consumed.
3) Commitment: signed 6-month minimum at estimated monthly spend >= $5k (TCV >= $30k) — if they don't meet the minimum, we recoup a prorated portion of the credit via final invoice.
4) Legal: include standard amendment language limiting precedent: "one-time onboarding promotion tied to SparkLabs cohort; not transferable; not precedent-setting."

I'll draft the finance note and can route the amendment to Legal for final wording. Monica — can you confirm DocuSign readiness and that Sales Ops can push this live by EOD Monday?

Marissa
